instructions.instruction: Verify gemspec dependency bounds match tested versions: `spec.add_dependency "rails", ">= 7.0", "< 8.0"` — bounds must reflect what CI actually tests. Unbounded or overclaiming constraints (`>= 5.2` without testing 5.2/6.x) are silent incompatibilities.
